items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: He was a good trumpet player. He had plenty, plenty of work out there in the country

ctx.x: Ed Waugh Clem. They call him Ed Waugh. He came from out around, uh, Paunchetour. I believe that is his home out in Paunchetour. He came from out there, yeah. He thought his daddy had a, had a sort of a farm out there, you know?
Talked sort of Creole? Ed Waugh?
